classification.age_anchor: Dated independent classification record or issuer announcement; never retrieval, current-list check, operator declaration or file upload date. Month-only notices use the first day of the earliest issue month conservatively.
classification.validity: Evaluate at selection, each collection, and publication of a current result; maximum 36 calendar months inclusive, or earlier known certificate expiry. Unknown award and expiry dates remain unknown.
classification.current_lookup_limitation: Hotelstars live records have no award/expiry fields; corroboration does not renew the dated evidence. Missing live search results are not themselves proof of withdrawal.
classification.contradictory_class_action: A current explicit operator class other than three excludes. Three-star Superior and Garni remain three-star subtypes; preserve the subtype.
classification.no_declaration_action: Record no_explicit_class_found; absence is not independent confirmation.
classification.unreachable_site_action: Unresolved operator or direct-booking checks prevent admission.
classification.check_cadence: Repeat operator exclusion and direct-booking checks at collection. Seek independent renewal evidence before any selected property reaches its ceiling.
classification.expiry_action: Withhold current class-qualified results after expiry without newer independent evidence. Retain historical observations with dates. No silent substitutions.
classification.notice: Independent DEHOGA classification notices have different vintages. Source dates, unknown certificate expiry and the 36-month ceiling travel with every sample and result. Current operator declarations can exclude, never admit.

size_decision.reason: All 107 fixed OSM frame objects have decisions: six eligible, 101 excluded under the unchanged evidence/room/direct-booking rules. Grimm’s and Allegra excluded for classification ceiling before January use; no admissible replacements established. Owner authorizes freezing six under the general exhausted-frame rule.
size_decision.limitation_notice: This panel uses fewer than eight properties. Its estimate carries wider uncertainty; the size of that difference has not been measured. The planning band is provisional editorial guidance, not a calibrated confidence interval or a guarantee of bookable prices.

algorithm: Use unrounded Haversine distance, Earth radius 6371008.8 m. Among candidates not excluded, find nearest remaining distance, form inclusive window through nearest +50 m, choose lowest immutable property_id in ASCII order, remove only that winner, repeat. Unknown eligibility in any first-eight window blocks selection. Every excluded object remains in audit.
jurisdiction: Germany: independent classification required under widely adopted Hotelstars/DEHOGA scheme; no UK operator-only exception.
source_facts: Individually named classification facts and source references only. External articles, photographs, logos and hotel text are not included or relicensed.
state: Dated geographic extract fixed. Six-property composition frozen under the general exhausted-frame rule; ±35% provisional band at six usable quotes per type. Session freeze awaits collector availability; no price observations or results. No room rates collected. Classification and current-bookability rechecks required before capture.
